statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55)
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the monitoring service
